title: The Society Book
logline: A village savings and funeral-aid society, run from a handwritten ledger, decides together how to help a member through a bad year, and turns down the easier option of interest that would eventually take the family's land.
human_question: What does a community actually choose, when it could profit from one of its own members' trouble instead?

premise.story: A mutual-aid or funeral-aid society's monthly meeting and its handling of a real member's real difficulty.
premise.place: A village hall or a member's home: ledgers, handwritten notes, a circle of people who know each other's business.
premise.experience: The unglamorous, procedural texture of a community actually looking after its own.

concept_links.why: The source's own example of wrong livelihood is lending to someone in difficulty at unjust interest in order to eventually take their land; a fair mutual-aid society is its deliberate opposite [C024-P:L47-L51].
This is a return, visible only much later, on years of steady fair dealing within a community, resonant with the idea that good action's fruit can arrive long after the act [C012-P:L50].
Many people's small, specific contributions add up to one outcome, none of them the whole story alone [C019-P:L49].

what_camera_could_observe: The monthly meeting and the ledger itself
Discussion of terms and how to help a member fairly
A member's situation being handled with visible care and discretion
The society's ordinary, procedural rhythm across meetings
what_must_be_real: The society's actual practice and a real member's real situation, shown only with their full, informed consent.

possible_arc.opening: The ledger opens for the month.
possible_arc.turn: A member's difficulty is raised and discussed.
possible_arc.ending_open: What the group actually decides, and how it plays out.

requirements: A long-running mutual-aid or funeral-aid society willing to be filmed
A real, current case, with full consent from the member involved
Trust and access built over enough time to observe genuine deliberation, not a performance for the camera

suggestions.name: A rural village with a long-running mutual-aid society
suggestions.why: Region-level suggestion for geographic variety; village mutual-aid and funeral societies of this kind are common across rural Sri Lanka.
suggestions.verify: No specific society, village or member has been identified or confirmed.

risks: Exposing members' private debts and hardship without full consent
Implying a real lender elsewhere in the community is a villain, without direct evidence
drop_if: Members will not consent to being identified even partially, or no real, current case is active

connections.note: Both concern honest dealing chosen over an available, more profitable wrong, at the level of a trade and of a community.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
evidence_class_note: All content is editorial proposal. Location suggestions are AI suggestions only; selection belongs to Chathura.
